blocks.title: Atomic orbital
blocks.text: Atomic orbital nucleus ke gird space ka woh three-dimensional hissa hai jahan electron ke milne ka imkaan (probability) sab se zyada hota hai.
Aaiye mukhtalif orbitals ko ek ek kar ke dekhte hain.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Orbit (Bohr) ek pakki circle jaisi line thi jis par electron chalta tha. Orbital koi line nahi, balke ek badal (cloud) jaisa hissa hai jahan electron ke milne ka chance sab se zyada hai.

items: Orbital nucleus ke gird woh three-dimensional hissa hai jahan electron milne ka imkaan sab se zyada hai.
